subject: Expansion: Meridian Health - new projects & API key provisioning
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@meridianhealth.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Expansion: Meridian Health - new projects & API key provisioning

Hi Aisha —

Thanks again for the great conversation yesterday. Meridian's pilot has been fantastic to watch and the product usage data you shared makes a strong case for enabling the next wave of projects across two additional lines of business (Patient Intake and Claims Triage).

To keep things moving, here's what we propose from Redwood:
- Add two new API key namespaces for Patient Intake and Claims Triage (separate key per project)
- Reserve an additional 4 vGPU pods (N4x) to keep latency within your SLOs during peak hours
- Extend the current term by 6 months to align with your Q2 rollout cadence (we'll provide a prorated amendment)

I've attached a short provisioning worksheet plus a draft MOP (method of provision) that lists responsibilities and expected dates. Can we schedule a 30-min kickoff next week to align on provisioning windows, MOP sign-off, and procurement steps?

Proposed times: Tue 11/24 10:00–10:30 or Wed 11/25 14:00–14:30 PT. Let me know which works and I'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks — excited to keep building with Meridian.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: Meridian_MultiApp_MOP_v1.pdf (application/pdf), provisioning_sheet.csv (text/csv)

From: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@meridianhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Meridian Procurement <procurement@meridianhealth.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@meridianhealth.com>, security@meridianhealth.com, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 07:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Expansion: Meridian Health - new projects & API key provisioning

Ben —

Appreciate the summary and the worksheet. We are interested in moving forward but need clarity on a few items before we lock dates:
1) Cost delta for the reserved capacity (monthly incremental vs current consumption) — procurement needs a clear line item.
2) Impact to our existing SLA (do the additional pods change response targets or monitoring windows?).
3) Security checklist: our InfoSec team (cc'd) will need the MOP plus any audit logs/data retention specifics.

Procurement (procurement@meridianhealth.com) can drive the formal PO once we have a short commercial summary and DocuSign-ready amendment.

I can do Tue 11/24 10:00 PT for the kickoff.

Thanks,
Aisha Patel
Director of Product Operations | Meridian Health
aisha.patel@meridianhealth.com

On Fri, Nov 20, 2026 at 9:12 AM Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai> wrote:

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Expansion: Meridian Health - new projects & API key provisioning

Laura / Monica —

Nice timing. Aisha confirmed 11/24 at 10:00 PT. Procurement and InfoSec are on the thread. Quick internal plan before the call:
- Laura: bring the pricing delta table (monthly reserved vGPU cost and one-time setup) and a one-page commercial summary for procurement.
- Monica: prepare the provisioning_sheet.csv with per-namespace TTLs, quota caps, and the suggested staggered activation schedule (we should recommend patient intake first, claims triage second).
- Ben: I'll own the MOP walkthrough and field any latency/SLO questions; have the SLA addendum draft ready.

Key asks from Meridian that we need to answer on the call: cost delta, SLA impact, security logging retention. We should keep answers short and promise follow-up docs where needed.

Action items (pre-call):
- Laura to upload commercial summary and delta table to the team Drive link (ETA EOD 11/23).
- Monica to update provisioning_sheet.csv with initial quota numbers and send to Mina (ETA 11/23 5pm PT).
- Ben to prepare a 2-slide MOP summary for the kickoff (ETA 11/24 morning).

I'll host the call and take notes.

Thanks — Mina
Mina Haddad
Head of Solutions | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai

> On Mon, Nov 23, 2026 at 7:05 AM Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@meridianhealth.com> wrote:
> > Appreciate the summary and the worksheet...

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@meridianhealth.com>, Meridian Procurement <procurement@meridianhealth.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Expansion: Meridian Health - new projects & API key provisioning

Aisha / team —

Thanks for the kickoff — appreciated the context. Following our discussion, attached is a commercial summary and the one-line pricing delta for the reserved capacity and additional keys. Highlights:
- Incremental reserved capacity: $12,500 / month (4 vGPU pods) — includes 24/7 capacity and priority routing.
- One-time provisioning/setup fee: $2,000 (covers key creation, service account configs, onboarding runbook).
- Term amendment: 6 months added to the current contract; prorated credit applied for existing unused committed spend.

We have prepared a DocuSign amendment to sign the term and capacity change: https://app.redwood.ai/docusign/MSG-9832 (stub link). Once signed, Monica will schedule the provisioning window.

Attachments: redwood_sla_addendum.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

Next steps:
- Procurement: please confirm PO process and expected lead time for DocuSign acceptance.
- InfoSec: we included the requested audit log retention fields in the SLA addendum; happy to expand if your team needs more detail.

Laura Bennett
Director, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0199

From: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@meridianhealth.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Expansion: Meridian Health - new projects & API key provisioning

Laura / Redwood team —

Thanks for the clear summary and the DocuSign link. Procurement will route the amendment this week; target for PO issuance is 11/30. A couple of clarifications before we finalize:
- Can you confirm staged activation? We want Patient Intake enabled 12/06 and Claims Triage enabled 12/20.
- Will the keys be provisioned as separate namespaces under the existing tenant or as new tenants? We prefer namespaces to keep telemetry unified.
- Any minimal notice window required for turning on the reserved pods?

We approve the pricing in principle. Please proceed with DocuSign and provisioning schedule once PO posts.

Regards,
Rajiv Menon
VP, Product Engineering | Meridian Health
rajiv.menon@meridianhealth.com
